name: lightcraft
description: RAW develop, landscape and portrait looks, batch grading, tone-curve transfer and virtual-copy review. Edits stay non-destructive.

interface.shortDescription: RAW develop, batch grading and culling with non-destructive edits
interface.longDescription: Lightcraft 照片管理与无损显影：持久任务锁、原子状态、只读核对、停止请求、明确剩余步骤建议、有界修订、绑定目标/原片/候选/设置的审阅，以及独立重开交付门禁；CLI 0.2.1/macOS arm64 开发预发行，不添加自动 hooks。
